## Combined
```{r}
# --- 1) pull the annotations and name them by cell barcodes ---
annot4 <- Tc_4$celltype
names(annot4) <- Cells(Tc_4)

annot8 <- Tc_8$celltype
names(annot8) <- Cells(Tc_8)

# --- 2) align to Tc cells ---
Tc$celltype_CD4 <- unname(annot4[Cells(Tc)])
Tc$celltype_CD8 <- unname(annot8[Cells(Tc)])

# --- 3) combine (prefer CD4, else CD8) ---
Tc$celltype <- dplyr::coalesce(
  as.character(Tc$celltype_CD4),
  as.character(Tc$celltype_CD8)
)

# sanity checks
table(is.na(Tc$celltype), Tc$PB)

# --- 4) subset to cells with a label ---
Tc <- subset(Tc, cells = Cells(Tc)[!is.na(Tc$celltype)])

# (Optional) set factor levels for plotting
Tc$celltype <- factor(
  Tc$celltype,
  levels = c(
  "CD4 TN",
  "CD4 TSM",
  "CD4 THDM",
  "CD4 TH1DM",
  "CD4 Regulatory",
  "CD4 TCTLDM",
  "CD4 Proliferating",
  "CD8 TN",
  "CD8 TM",
  "CD8 Tc1DM",
  "CD8 TCTLDM", 
  "CD8 Tc1-CTLDM" ,
  "CD8 Proliferating"))

table(Tc$celltype)
```

## ProjectTIL annotation
```{r}
ref <- load.reference.map(ref = "../data/PTIL_refs/ref_TILAtlas_mouse_v1.rds")
ref_LCMV <- load.reference.map(ref = "../data/PTIL_refs/ref_TILAtlas_mouse_v1.rds")
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(Tc) <- "RNA"
query.projected.ptil <- ProjecTILs.classifier(Tc, ref = ref, ndim = 10, reduction = "umap", split.by = "PID", filter.cells = F, ncores = 8)
```

```{r}
levels <- c("CD4_NaiveLike", "CD8_NaiveLike" , "Th1", "Tfh","Treg", "CD8_EarlyActiv",  "CD8_EffectorMemory", "CD8_Tpex/ex") 

query.projected.ptil$functional.cluster <- factor(query.projected.ptil$functional.cluster)

table(query.projected.ptil$functional.cluster)

query.projected.ptil$functional.cluster <- dplyr::case_when(
  query.projected.ptil$functional.cluster == "CD8_Tpex" ~ "CD8_Tpex/ex",
  query.projected.ptil$functional.cluster == "CD8_Tex"  ~ "CD8_Tpex/ex",
  TRUE ~ query.projected.ptil$functional.cluster 
)

query.projected.ptil$functional.cluster <- factor(query.projected.ptil$functional.cluster, levels = levels)

Tc$PTIL.ID <- query.projected.ptil$functional.cluster
Tc_4$PTIL.ID  <- Tc$PTIL.ID
Tc_8$PTIL.ID  <- Tc$PTIL.ID

table(Tc$PTIL.ID)
```

## LCMV
```{r}
DefaultAssay(Tc) <- "RNA"
query.projected.lcmv <- ProjecTILs.classifier(Tc, ref = ref_LCMV, ndim = 10, reduction = "umap", split.by = "PID", filter.cells = F, ncores = 8)
levels <- c("CD4_NaiveLike", "CD8_NaiveLike" , "Th1", "Tfh","Treg", "CD8_EarlyActiv",  "CD8_EffectorMemory", "CD8_Tpex/ex")
```

```{r}
query.projected.lcmv$functional.cluster <- factor(query.projected.lcmv$functional.cluster)

table(query.projected.lcmv$functional.cluster)

query.projected.lcmv$functional.cluster <- dplyr::case_when(
  query.projected.lcmv$functional.cluster == "CD8_Tpex" ~ "CD8_Tpex/ex",
  query.projected.lcmv$functional.cluster == "CD8_Tex"  ~ "CD8_Tpex/ex",
  TRUE ~ query.projected.lcmv$functional.cluster 
)

query.projected.lcmv$functional.cluster <- factor(query.projected.lcmv$functional.cluster, levels = levels)
table(query.projected.lcmv$functional.cluster)

Tc$LCMV.ID <- query.projected.lcmv$functional.cluster
Tc_4$LCMV.ID  <- Tc$LCMV.ID
Tc_8$LCMV.ID  <- Tc$LCMV.ID
```

# Mouse
## Load old data
```{r}
Tc <- readRDS("../data/Mouse/T.integrated.rds")
Tc$PB <- Tc$Tissue
Idents(Tc) <- "PB"
Tc <- RenameIdents(Tc,"Spleen" = "Spleen", "Stable" = "Plaque",  "Unstable" = "Plaque")
Tc$PB <- Idents(Tc)
DefaultAssay(Tc) <- "RNA"

```

```{r}
Idents(Tc) <- "celltype"
feat <- list(
    Lin = c("Cd4","Cd8a"),
    Naive = c("Ccr7", "Sell","Tcf7", "Klf2"),
    Activation = c("Cd44", "Cd69","Ifng", "Ccl5"),
    Cytotoxic = c( "Gzmb","Nkg7","Runx3"),
    Treg = c( "Foxp3","Il2ra", "Ctla4"),
    Proliferation = c( "Stmn1","Mki67", "Top2a"))

Dot <- seu_gene_sets_dot(Tc,
    feat,                         # named list: list("Group A"=c("G1","G2(+)"), "Group B"=c(...))
    group_by = "celltype",              # meta.data column (like DotPlot(group.by=))
    assay    = NULL,                   # NULL => DefaultAssay(seu)
    use_scaled_for_fill = TRUE,        # TRUE: fill = avg.exp.scaled; FALSE: avg.exp (raw)
    # aesthetics (DotPlot-like)
    size_range   = c(1, 5),           # bubble size range
    size_breaks  = c(10, 20, 40),  # % expressing
    size_limits  = c(0, 50),          # % expressing limits
    fill_limits  = c(-1, 1),           # when use_scaled_for_fill=TRUE
    fill_palette = c("blue", "lightgrey", "darkred"),
    x_label      = "",
    base_size    = 10,
    x_angle      = 45,
    x_text_size  = 10,
    y_text_size  = 10,
    x_title_size = 10,
    bracket_text_size = 3,
    bracket_tick = 0.25,
    # layout/headroom controls
    y_expand_add_bottom = 0.60,        # add bottom padding (lifts dots off x-axis)
    y_expand_add_top    = 0.25,        # add top padding (reduces headroom)
    y_bracket_offset    = 0.80,        # bracket baseline above top row (in "row" units)
    y_label_offset      = 0.18,        # text above bracket baseline
    plot_margin_cm      = c(1.2, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6),  # top, right, bottom, left
    # NEW: clustering options
    cluster_groups = F,            # reorder rows (clusters) by hclut
    cluster_genes  = "within_group",
    dist_method    = "euclidean",
    hclust_method  = "complete") & theme(text = element_text(family = "Times"))


DimPlot(Tc, label = T)
svglite("../docs/assets/00-Annotate/cluster_data.svg", width = 8, height = 4)
Dot
invisible(dev.off())
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/00-Annotate/cluster_data.svg")
```
